text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've become the trainer of Rice Shower, a racer who lacks confidence in herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But rather than remain a useless girl who brings misfortune, she's determined to change into a blue rose that brings joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet her first day of training is indeed rife with misfortune, and she ends up arriving very late.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before, she was trying to catch up to the other racers on her own, but I extend a helping hand to her and promise to make her talent as a racer bloom.
